transit.detail: Free transit service year-round to and from Winter Park Resort, Downtown Winter Park, Fraser, Granby and Grand Lake

nameOrigin.text: The town was formerly known as Eastom, for George Eastom, who laid out the town site in 1871; the spelling of Fraser was originally Frazier, after Reuben Frazier.

timeline.text: George Eastom laid out the town site, first known as Eastom.
William Zane Cozens, formerly sheriff in Central City, moved his family to the Fraser Valley and began building the ranch and stage stop.
Billy Cozens was appointed postmaster of the Fraser Post Office.
